class.name: JRPGShowTextCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: shows a message for the player to read.
class.description: Asks the player to read [member text] through the presentation port (a [code]"message"[/code] request, see [JRPGLocalPort]), with an optional face on the left and a speaker name above, then goes on once it was read. The text may hold control codes (see [JRPGMessageText]). When the next command is Show Choices or Input Number, the message does not wait for the player at its end: they show beside it. Authority: client (it only presents).

members.member: The message window's background: a window, a dimmed band or nothing.
The path of the texture drawn on the left of the message; an [AtlasTexture] picks one face of a sheet. Empty: no face.
Where the message window shows: at the top, in the middle or at the bottom of the screen.
The name shown above the message. Empty: no name box.
The text, with control codes. Four lines fit in the window.
The key the text is translated through ("map3.ev7.k9f2c1"). The authoring tools give it when they create the command; when the project has a translation for it, the player reads the translation.

constants.constant: The message window's frame and background.
At the top of the screen.
In the middle of the screen.
At the bottom of the screen.
